{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and internal orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Confirm only two channels exist
channels = filtered_df['channel'].unique()
print(f'Channels after filtering: {channels}')

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = filtered_df.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Channel revenue: {channel_revenue.to_dict()}')

# Determine highest
highest_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
print(f'Highest revenue channel: {highest_channel}')"}
